title: Suddhikasuttaṃ
text: 550 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Valāhakakāyike vo, bhikkhave, deve desessāmi. Taṃ suṇātha. Katame ca, bhikkhave, valāhakakāyikā devā? Santi, bhikkhave, sītavalāhakā devā; santi uṇhavalāhakā devā; santi abbhavalāhakā devā; santi vātavalāhakā devā; santi vassavalāhakā devā – ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, ‘valāhakakāyikā devā’’’ti. Paṭhamaṃ.
